newsitem.title: GERMANY: BOE's George says EMI agreed paper on ECB policy.
newsitem.headline: BOE's George says EMI agreed paper on ECB policy.

text.p: Bank of England governor Eddie George said on Tuesday the European Monetary Institute's (EMI) council has approved a paper on the monetary policy of the future European Central Bank (ECB) at a meeting on Tuesday.
The paper, which is expected to sketch out the blueprint for the ECB's monetary policy tools, will be presented at a news conference in Frankfurt on Friday.
Asked to comment on the outcome of the meeting as he was leaving the EMI building in Frankfurt, George said the paper was "a very solid piece of work."
He added, "we will be able to see the real shape of the arrangement on Friday but not the final details."
